title: Nuclear silo shutdowns and anti-nuclear messaging

tellings.quote: lot of a lot of the nuclear stuff is like shutting down silos and maybe and then a lot of the messaging that people get seems to be like you're going to destroy yourselves in some sort of nuclear holocaust

plain: UFOs are said to have shut down nuclear missiles in their underground launch sites, and people who report contact often describe being warned that humanity will destroy itself in a nuclear war. Michels raises this in a conversation with a Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, drawing on the work of a researcher named Robert Hastings, and he offers it as a sign that whatever is behind the phenomenon is especially concerned with nuclear weapons.
